title: Complete WebviewPanel PR 4880: safe IPC, native integration, lifecycle and regression coverage
description: PR 4880 follow-up: merge current master; remove frontend navigation/content IPC; repair method IDs, panel lifecycle, desktop backends and example; add regression and native smoke coverage. Windows and GTK3 native smoke tests passed, along with Go race checks and 1226 frontend tests. macOS and current GTK4 integration require CI/reviewer validation.
close_reason: Implemented and pushed safe IPC, native desktop backends, lifecycle/layout fixes, example and regression coverage. Windows, GTK3, macOS and GTK4 native validation passed; 1226 runtime tests and two example scheduler tests passed. Review requests and replies posted on PR 4880; upstream workflow approval and maintainer review remain external.

title: Validate WebviewPanel on macOS and current GTK4 desktop
description: Fork CI run 33960679942 passed macOS application/asset tests, panel race tests, native smoke, production and server builds. GTK4 application/asset and race tests passed; native smoke blocked by Ubuntu runner AppArmor user-namespace permissions. Add a per-executable profile and rerun both platforms with teardown fix.
close_reason: Fork CI run 33961374339 passed on macOS 14 and Ubuntu 24.04 GTK4: application and asset-server tests, panel race tests, real native smoke tests, production and server builds. Source matches PR e5f75a353 except the isolated validation workflow.

title: Prevent repeated native panel teardown when destruction races creation
description: CodeRabbit identified queued Destroy and post-create cleanup both releasing the same native view. Add a UI-thread cleanup guard and regressions for callbacks dispatched during and after creation.
close_reason: Shared UI-thread teardown guard defers release until creation finishes and prevents repeated native destruction. Both callback orderings covered by regression tests; Windows race and native smoke pass.

title: Keep generated panel names unique beside explicit names
description: An explicit panel-N name can collide with the next automatically generated name, making frontend lookup nondeterministic. Skip occupied generated names and cover lookup in a regression test.
close_reason: Generated names skip explicit names and occupied suffixes under the window panel lock. Regression verifies unambiguous lookup and consistent options; Windows panel race tests pass.

title: Serialize panel example resize updates
description: CodeRabbit found overlapping frontend SetBounds requests can finish out of order. Coalesce pending measurements while a request is in flight and verify delayed responses and error recovery.
close_reason: Example coalesces resize measurements and awaits each native bounds update before applying the next. Delayed-response and error-recovery tests pass; example builds. Navigation and visibility controls prevent overlapping clicks.
